text:
maya: Heads up — Verdantix onboarding hit a tail-latency and cost signal in our dashboard. Their avg p95 jumped to 1.8s on chat generation (recent spike after activation). Can we propose a lightweight mitigation they can accept this week?
raj: Saw that. Usage is spiky (batch of long prompts from their data exporter). Token cost up ~42% month-over-month. Renewal convo next quarter, so want low-risk fixes first.
maya: My suggestion: 1) try compact quantized model for non-critical calls, 2) route long prompts to Dedicated pool in us-west for lower variance, 3) enable prefix KV cache for repeated prompts. Low-impact config change, minimal eval needed. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
oliver: Agree on order. Quick perf numbers — we tested quantized 8-bit on a similar workload: p50 unchanged, p95 down ~25%, cost per token -32%. Caveat: hallucination risk slightly higher on few-shotative prompts; need a small prompt set to sanity-check quality.
jin: For routing: we can add a rule in routing table to send requests with tokens>1024 to dedicated-usw and keep <=1024 on shared-hosted. Should we do a gradual canary?
maya: Yes canary. Proposal: 5% traffic to dedicated-usw for 48h, reviewers: oliver + raj. If metrics good, scale to 30% then switch thresholds.
raj: I'll draft the canary config. Also add a fallback policy to the previous model for errors/timeouts.
maya: Also need enable KV cache for their common prompt prefix — Olly can provide top-10 prefixes for the week.
oliver: I'll extract prefixes and run 50k-sample eval against quantized model. Will post results. Expect under 24h.
deploy-bot: New routing rule draft created: routes/verdantix/long-requests -> dedicated-usw (canary=5%, ttl=48h). ID: r-9f8b2
jin: Ops checklist: ensure Dedicated pool has headroom, autoscale policy to +20% burst, monitor p99, error rate, and regen-rate. I'll add alerts to the Verdantix team channel.
maya: If quantized eval passes quality thresholds (<=1% regression on our eval set), we present to the customer as opt-in pilot. Need a one-paragraph summary for their PM. I'll write that once Olly posts numbers.
raj: Quick note on billing: we should show estimated cost delta in the pilot proposal (approx -28% unit cost if quant + routing). I'll prepare the numbers and attach to the summary.
maya: Nice. Owners: maya (CS lead), oliver (ml eval), raj (cust config + pricing), jin (ops). Expected timeline: eval + canary config by EOD tomorrow.
raj: tagging @verdantix_pm in the thread when we have the pilot summary.
maya: Thanks team — small, reversible changes. Keeping renewal lock-in friendly. :thumbsup:
